steps.caption: Estimates
steps.narration: A client asked for a change. Here's how to edit an estimate and send it again.

steps.caption: Open the estimate
steps.narration: On the Estimates page, click the estimate's number.

steps.caption: Title, tax, deposit, message
steps.narration: At the top you can change the title, the tax percent, the deposit and your message.

steps.caption: Change a quantity
steps.narration: Each line has a name, a quantity, a unit and a price. We'll raise the plank to nine hundred eighty square feet.

steps.caption: Scope of work per line
steps.narration: Under each line you can write its scope of work.

steps.caption: Add line
steps.narration: Add line puts in another row.

steps.caption: The total updates
steps.narration: The total updates as you type.

steps.caption: Save changes
steps.narration: Then choose Save changes. The client's link shows the new version right away.

steps.caption: New quantity and total
steps.narration: The estimate now shows the new quantity and the new total.

steps.caption: Resend
steps.narration: Saving doesn't email anyone. To tell the client, choose Resend.

steps.caption: New send time, valid until
steps.narration: This line shows the new send time, and how long the estimate stays valid.

steps.caption: History
steps.narration: History keeps the record: updated, then sent.

steps.caption: Menu: Estimates
steps.narration: You'll find Estimates in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to edit and resend an estimate | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of changing an estimate after you have sent it in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will open the estimate, edit a line, check the new total, save, and resend it to the client. History keeps a record of the update and the send.
